$comment: Physical Security Work Zone Confirmation. Rows come from PS_Zone-Attestation-Assignments (filtered to the signed-in user's email). Each row shows the area's current zone (CurrentZone) to confirm, or to change through the dropdown, and saves one item to PS_Zone-Attestation-Responses: ZoneSelection = the answer, PreviousZone = the current zone, ZoneChanged = whether they differ, Attestation = Confirmed (submitting is the confirmation). An area with no CurrentZone gets the dropdown straight away. Both lists live on /teams/FCUWebDatastores (target.siteUrl and source.siteUrl); the page runs on /sites/FCUPortal. Users need read on the Assignments list and Add + View (own items only) on Responses. form.headerNote (the review message) and form.headerUser (who is confirming) sit in the header band; form.vars.accessListUrl is the employee access list page (ps-zone-attestation.access.json), the button of the feature callout at the top. errorLog names the list a failed load, save or start-up writes one item to; a SharePoint list rule there emails the admin (docs/02-sharepoint-data.md). The job aid and other links live in the resources panel (ps-zone-attestation.resources.json), not here. Bilingual: every { en, fr } pair follows the language from bilingual/intl.js. Zone VALUES (Public, Public Plus, Standards, Secure Restricted, High Security) are saved in English whatever the language, and CurrentZone must hold them spelled exactly so; only the labels are translated. The French texts, the zone descriptions and the contact are drafts, to be replaced.

description.en: [Placeholder] Day-to-day operations for authorized staff only. Visitors need approval and an escort. Lock workstations when you step away and clear desks at the end of the day.

description.en: [Placeholder] Named staff only, with access reviewed every quarter. Entry is logged at the door. No personal devices on the floor; report propped doors or tailgating right away.

description.en: [Placeholder] Critical assets such as vaults and server rooms. Two-person access only, recorded on camera. Every entry is pre-approved, signed in and out, and nothing leaves without sign-off.
